reviews.name: Supti Kar
reviews.text:
I have recently completed my B1 course at GLAB, and I am very satisfied with my learning experience. The grammar lessons were explained so clearly that my understanding improved a lot. I also feel much more confident speaking and using German now.

One thing I really appreciated was that homework was mandatory, which helped me stay disciplined and practice regularly. In class, we discussed the homework in detail, which gave us the opportunity to clarify doubts, understand grammar rules better and learn from common mistakes.

I would highly recommend this course to anyone who wants to learn German seriously and effectively.

reviews.name: Tanvir Azad
reviews.text:
I have just completed my B1 German course with GLAB, and I can confidently recommend it to anyone who is genuinely committed to learning the language.

The teaching methods are clear, well-structured and easy to follow. At the same time, the instructor maintains high standards and does not tolerate slacking off, which keeps everyone engaged throughout the course. Attending classes consistently and completing the homework are essential if you want to get the most out of the program.

It requires dedication and effort, but the progress you make and the results you achieve are well worth it.

reviews.name: Hamdan Munir
reviews.text: Everyones learning pattern is different. I need someone who will push me. This course and Rayhan bhaia was awsome. If you are dedicated, feel free to take this. And my suggestion is, go all the way from A1 to B1 without any stop and never miss homework or lectures.

reviews.name: Hasan Khan
reviews.text: Very serious and passionate program.

reviews.name: Senjuti Roy
reviews.text:
I've just finished the Foundation, A1, A2, and B1 levels of my German course with GLAB - German Language Academy of Bangladesh, and I'm more than happy with the learning experience.

The way they teach — with clear explanations, regular homework, engaging classes, and real-life examples and scenarios — made a huge difference.

All of that really helped me build confidence in speaking, reading, and especially understanding German grammar.

If you're serious about learning German, I'd definitely recommend GLAB - German Language Academy of Bangladesh.

reviews.name: মাহাদী হাসান
reviews.text:
আসসালামু আলাইকুম সম্মানিত সকল।

মাতৃভাষা ছাড়া নতুন একটা ভাষা আয়ত্ব করা কতটুকু কঠিন এবং সময়সাপেক্ষ তা আমরা বুঝি। এরকমই জার্মান ভাষা। যখন এই ভাষাটা কোথা থেকে শুরু করবো, কি দিয়ে শুরু করবো, না জেনেই নিজে নিজে শুরু করে যখন হতাশায় ডুবগিয়াম তখন GLAB সম্পর্কে জানতে পারি আমার বন্ধুদের কাছ থেকে। বন্ধুদের সাফল্য এবং রায়হান ভাই নিজ জেলার হওয়ায় আগ্রহটা আরো বেড়ে যায়।

রেজিস্ট্রেশন সম্পন্ন করে নির্বাচিত হওয়ার এবং আলহামদুলিল্লাহ হয়ে যাই।

শুরু হয় জার্মান ভাষার অক্ষর চেনা দিয়ে হাতেখড়ি যা A1+Foundation level. সেই থেকে A2, B1 এর প্রত্যেকটি ধাপ সম্পন্ন করে শেষতক আসা।

একটি নতুন ভাষা শিখার জন্য নিজের যে ধৈর্য, ভাইয়ার শিক্ষার ধরন, ব্যাচমেট দের বন্ধুভাবাপন্ন মনোভাব সবই এই যাত্রাকে সুগম করার একটি প্রভাবক।

আ, বে, সে থেকে শুরু করে এখন জার্মান ভাষায় একটা বাক্য বলতে পারার আনন্দ বলে বুঝানোর মতো না।

ধন্যবাদ ভাইয়াকে নিজের এই মূল্যবান জ্ঞান GLAB এর মাধ্যমে আমাদেরকে ছড়িয়ে দেয়ার জন্য।

এবং নতুন ভাষা লার্নার দের প্রতি ছোট্ট একটা মতামত,

পর্যাপ্ত সময়, শিখার আগ্রহ, GLAB এর রুলস এন্ড রেগুলেশন মেনে চলা, কো-অপারেট করা এই বিষয়গুলো মেনে চলতে পারলে ইনশাল্লাহ ভালো ফলাফল সন্নিকটে।

reviews.name: Syed Wahid Arman
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of completing my German A1 to B1 levels with GLAB. It was an excellent experience.

Md Rayhanur Rahman's teaching style is clear, patient, and engaging, which made the learning both effective and ever lasting. Strong teaching and explanation have helped me to gain confidence in speaking and understanding German language. I strongly recommend GLAB for learning and understanding the German language.

reviews.name: Wasif Islam
reviews.text: The 6-month journey from A1 to B1 was definitely worth it. The mandatory class attendance and homework pushed us to stay committed until the end. I saw quite a few people who couldn't handle the strictness and left, but for me, that pressure from Vai was exactly what I needed. Along the way, we also became a small family, supporting each other throughout the process.

reviews.name: Rabiul Sany Khan
reviews.text: GLAB is like a language learning family. Through intensive course, there was a lot of improvment in a very short time. GLAB has become a part of my life's story. A teacher like Rayhan vaiya is difficult to find who is highly supportive and pushes his students beyond boundaries. I am indebted to GLAB not only for teaching me language, but also to discipline myself.

reviews.name: Jiban Kumar Ray
reviews.text:
A big thank you to 🙏 GLAB - German Language Academy of Bangladesh & Mohammad Rayhanur Rahman for guiding me through an amazing journey in learning the German language!

👉 Just 6 months ago, I only knew the alphabet – "A, B, C..."
👉 Today, I've successfully reached B1 level!
👉 Now, I can speak more confidently in everyday situations.
👉 It has been an intense (6.30 AM on the weekends 😅) but truly rewarding experience.

Some highlights:

💬 The Teacher explains grammar and vocabulary with clear, practical examples.
💬 Classes are well-structured, engaging, and focused on real-life communication.
💬 I didn't just learn the language. I also gained a better understanding of German culture and communication.

✅ I highly recommend GLAB to anyone who is serious about learning German!
❌ ফাঁকিবাজ দূরে থাকবেন।

reviews.name: Mahmudul Haque Arfan
reviews.text:
Zusammenfassend: Endlich habe ich den Mut, Deutsch zu sprechen. Es ist mir egal, ob ich Fehler mache.

I was trying different ways to get the understanding and the fluency of German language. Mainly, I lacked the courage. GLAB enabled that to me. I tried to speak but always thought I couldn't keep up. Nowadays, I always try to keep the conversation in German. Still, I have fear, I check thousand times before writing something. But, somewhere throughout the journey, I stopped caring about what others would say, rather I focused on my objective. And that, is to learn and speak as much as I can. I would like to thank Rayhan bhai and the GLAB team to push me as much as they could. At first, it seems an adversary but in the end, if you think through leaving your ego behind, it is a lot of us would want, isn't it? And the connection with other fellow countrymen is an added bonus!

reviews.name: Lamia Mannan
reviews.text:
An Outstanding German Learning Journey at GLAB! 🇩🇪

I'm so glad I chose GLAB for my A1-B1 intensive German course. From the very beginning, the experience has been outstanding. Well structured classes, clear goals, and a strong focus on both grammar and communication skills, dedication of the Instructor towards teaching the language. Though it is mentioned to be an online course but it never felt online rather felt it was offline.

And whatever I say about Rayhan bhai would not be enough. Yes he is really strict and that is the only reason why I could complete the whole course. And his main goal is that his students can learn from the platform. The effort and dedication he puts towards teaching German, really deserves a big appreciation.

After this course, I feel much more confident in my German skills and motivated to move forward to the next level. I can truly say I've made visible progress, and I'm thankful to GLAB and Rayhan bhai for guiding me through it.

If you're looking for a reliable and high-quality German language academy, I wholeheartedly recommend GLAB. They genuinely care about their students success. Danke schön, GLAB, for everything! 🤙✨

reviews.name: MH Sumon
reviews.text:
I started my German language journey from A1 to B1 under the guidance of our incredible instructor, Rayhan Vai. The way he teaches grammar is not only clear but truly mesmerizing. His dedication and consistent effort to ensure every student understands the concepts deeply are genuinely admirable.

What sets him apart is his disciplined approach. His strictness about attending every class and completing homework regularly has tremendously strengthened my learning. This structure pushed me to stay on track and aim higher in mastering the language.

He genuinely loves teaching, and that passion reflects in every session. His energy, motivation, and methods have deeply inspired me to pursue German more seriously. I honestly feel that if I had found him earlier, I would have progressed even faster and with greater confidence.

Overall, learning with Rayhan Vai has been a great experience. Highly recommend him if you're serious about learning German in a fun but focused way!

reviews.name: Hemayet Ullah
reviews.text: আমি মনে করি এটি শুধু একটি ভাষা শেখার কোর্স না, নিজেকে ফোর্স করে ঝালিয়ে নেওয়ার সর্বোত্তম মাধ্যম। সৌভাগ্যক্রমে GLAB এ পড়ার সুযোগ হয়েছিলো আর আমার জীবনে যুক্ত হয়েছে আরেকজন সেরা শিক্ষক "রায়হান স্যার"।

reviews.name: Israt Jahan Surovi
reviews.text:
I've completed my German language journey from Foundation to B1 level at GLAB, and I can confidently say it has been the best learning experience. Before joining, I tried various platforms like YouTube and other online resources, but nothing came close to the structured, supportive, and effective environment at GLAB.

What truly sets GLAB apart is the incredible teaching approach by Mohammad Rayhanur Rahman. His method of explaining complex German grammar in our native language makes even the hardest concepts easy to grasp. Learning a new language is never easy, but with his guidance, it becomes not just manageable but enjoyable.

The discipline and structure at GLAB remind me of the way our parents used to motivate us to excel in our studies! Strict, but always with care and purpose. That unique blend of pressure and support truly helped me stay focused and committed.

I'm deeply grateful to GLAB for this amazing journey, and I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone serious about learning German and building a strong network along the way.

reviews.name: Zerin
reviews.text:
#FREEBASIC course #review

Mohammad Rayhanur Rahman এতো চমৎকার এবং গুরুত্বপূর্ণ এই কোর্সটা কেন ফ্রিতে নিচ্ছেন সেটা উনিই জানেন, তবে এটা থেকে আমার এবং আমার মতো অনেকের যে পরিমান উপকার হয়েছে সেটা শুধুমাত্র যারা GLAB এর সাথে সংযুক্ত তারাই যানেন।

reviews.name: Fahad Dewan
reviews.text:
Basic foundation course personal review:

I joined the GLAB Free Foundation Course on the 30th of January. I waited 2 weeks to write this review so that I could be as detailed as possible.

I would like to summarize the positives and negatives of the course in my opinion:

1. Anyone can learn the language: Some people give up the great benefits of going to Germany (and go to other countries) simply because they dont believe they can learn the language at this age. But in just 2 weeks of doing this course, not only do I believe that I can learn the language to at least the B1 level in the coming months, I also WANT to learn the language.

2. Strictness is important: Rayhan bhaia is quite strict about class attendance and submission of homework. If you miss a class and HW, you cannot continue the course. But this was also a great way to keep us motivated and consistent with the course.

3. Great course structure: In many institutions, I saw that the courses start with greetings and sentences, which I believe made learning quite difficult. But this course had a different approach, starting with alphabets and pronunciations- which made learning much easier and enjoyable.

4. Learning 500+ vocabulary in 2 weeks: One of the most important parts of this course was the separate vocabulary copy where, as part of classwork and homework, we wrote over 500 words (including their articles and plural forms) over the 2 weeks. This meant that in just 10 classes, we are now able to understand the meanings of many common and uncommon German words.

In summary, the GLAB Free Foundation course is a great way to get started with learning German. For me, it gave me the belief that I can learn the language if I put in the effort and that I CAN LEARN IT WELL!

For everyone out there who think that Deutsch is an IMPOSSIBLE language, always remember:

"It is impossible until it is done", and after finishing this foundation course, you will not have learned the complete language, but you will have learned many things you had thought to be impossible.

Vielen Dank Mohammad Rayhanur Rahman, der Lehrer. Bis der A1 Kurs.

reviews.name: Tasnim Chowdhury Monisha
reviews.text:
জার্মান ভাষার মত রসকসহীন ভাষা শেখার প্রতি আমার কখনো তেমন কোন আগ্রহ ছিলনা। GLAB এ registration করার আগে অনেক good reviews দেখেছিলাম কিন্তু আমি confused ছিলাম নিজেকে নিয়ে যে আমি কতটুকু বুঝতে পারবো, শিখতে পারবো, efforts দিতে পারবো!! অনেক confusions নিয়েই Free basic course এ class শুরু করি। প্রথম দিন class এ Alphabet গুলো যখন 1st try এই ঠিক মত বলতে পারছিলাম তখন মজাই লাগছিল। এরপর regular class, homework সবকিছু ঠিকঠাক মত করতে দেখলাম ভালই লাগতেসে।

আর এটাই আমাদের mentor Mohammad Rayhanur Rahman ভাইয়ার magic !!! Student দের মধ্যে ভালো লাগা তৈরি করে দেয়া।

German language এর প্রতি যতই অনাগ্রহ থাকুক না কেন ভাইয়ার গোছানো পড়ানোর সিস্টেমের মাধ্যমে যে কেউ এই ভাষাকে আগ্রহ নিয়ে শিখতে পারবে।

ভাইয়া আপনাকে অনেক অনেক ধন্যবাদ এত ধৈর্য নিয়ে আমাদেরকে এত সুন্দরভাবে german ভাষা শেখার সুযোগ করে দেয়া এবং অনুপ্রেরনা যোগানোর জন্য।

আপনার guidlines নিয়ে জার্মান ভাষা আমি শিখতে পারবো ইনশাল্লাহ।

reviews.name: চৈতি
reviews.text: জার্মান ভাষাটা যেমন গুরুগম্ভীর, ভেবেছিলাম ক্লাসটাও তেমনি বোরিং হবে কিন্তু আমার ধারণা পুরাটাই পাল্টে গেছে। ৬ষ্ঠ ব্যাচের প্রথম ক্লাসটা আজ করে ফেললাম। দারুন লেগেছে বিশেষ করে রায়হান ভাইয়ের রুলস রেগুলেশন আর পড়ানোর পদ্ধতি। এখানে আসলে পড়তেই হবে কোন ছাড় নেই। হয় পড় শিখ, না হয় বের হয়ে যাও।। একদিনেই অনেককিছু জানলাম।। অসংখ্য ধন্যবাদ ভাইয়াকে এত ব্যস্ততার মধ্যেও আমাদের আপনার মূল্যবান সময় দেওয়ার জন্য আর আমাকে ৬ষ্ঠ ব্যাচে সুযোগ করে দেওয়ার জন্য।

reviews.name: Anarul Haque
reviews.text:
GLAB Experience

I have waited a few months for this opportunity, finally got enrolled in the 28th batch, and finished the Foundation Course. We had an amazing two weeks of learning with a highly committed teacher. His method of instruction, along with the strict rules and regulations, made the lessons more engaging and manageable. Thank you, Nawrin apu for introducing me to this platform.

NB: Because we often take FREE (financially) things for granted, I would advise potential students to carefully review the course requirements, especially the class schedule and before enrolling, consider whether they can commit to attending all of the classes and turning in their assignments on time. And while attending the classes, please try to be a responsible student.

Happy Learning!
